notes: Sync calls: recommender -> persistence over load-balanced HTTP REST/JSON (ServiceLoadBalancer.loadBalanceRESTOperation, LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntities) at TrainingSynchronizer.java:138 (generatedb/finished poll), :184 (orderitems), :194 (orders). recommender -> recommender multicast of GET train/timestamp at TrainingSynchronizer.java:214-215 (ServiceLoadBalancer.multicastRESTOperation; the comment at :213 says 'since we are not registered ourselves, we can multicast to all services'). recommender -> registry over HTTP: RegistryClient.java:244-245 (PUT register/heartbeat), :264-265 (DELETE), :193-195 (GET server list).

Messages: no topic or consumer group is published or consumed by recommender application code in the given files. Kieker monitoring records go to a RabbitMQ queue named 'kieker' (kieker.monitoring.properties:28,32) via ChunkingCollector chunkSize=32 (:33), deferredWriteDelay=500 (:34), taskRunInterval=20 (:36); this is telemetry, not application messaging.

Writer selection: kieker.monitoring.properties:40 defaults to FileWriter; start.sh:33-36 switches to ChunkingCollector/AMQP when RABBITMQ_HOST != unset; compose sets RABBITMQ_HOST: "rabbitmq" for recommender (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:103). Kieker AMQP connection heartbeat is overridden to KIEKER_AMQP_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS=900 (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:19,104,28); that is the Kieker-to-RabbitMQ connection heartbeat, not the registry heartbeat.

Traces: Tracing.init (Tracing.java:42, called from RecommenderStartup.java:70) builds a JaegerTracer with ConstSampler(true) and no reporter or sender configured; the Jaeger destination and flush interval are library default, not in these files. No metrics or log shipper is configured in these files.

Registry timings: heartbeat interval 2500 ms (RegistryClient.java:65, scheduleAtFixedRate :159-160). Registry failure timeout and cleanup interval are not stated in the given files (registry service files not provided): library default, not in these files. Load balancer refresh 2500 ms, initial delay 1000 ms (RegistryClient.java:64,161-162).

Registration timing: register() (and thus the heartbeat) is only called inside the runAfterServiceIsAvailable(PERSISTENCE) callback after TrainingSynchronizer.retrieveDataAndRetrain() returns (RecommenderStartup.java:73-76); retrieveDataAndRetrain -> waitForPersistence loops forever with waits 1000..60000 ms then 120000 ms (TrainingSynchronizer.java:58-61,135-164). Until then the recommender does not heartbeat. The heartbeat itself runs on a dedicated single-thread ScheduledExecutorService (RegistryClient.java:69-70), separate from servlet request threads.

Periodic retraining: RetrainDaemon (RetrainDaemon.java:25) started only if recommenderLoopTime > 0 (RecommenderStartup.java:80-81); image default RECOMMENDER_RETRAIN_LOOP_TIME 0 (dockerbase/Dockerfile:25), compose sets none for recommender, so disabled by default.

Health: no healthcheck key in the recommender compose block (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:96-107) and no HEALTHCHECK in the recommender Dockerfile (services/tools.descartes.teastore.recommender/Dockerfile:1-4) or the base image Dockerfile (dockerbase/Dockerfile:1-55). The service exposes GET train/isready (TrainEndpoint.java:99-100) but nothing in the given files polls it as a container health check.
Replica count not stated (no deploy.replicas in docker-compose_kieker.yaml:96-107); Compose default applies.

replicas.note: library default, not in these files: the recommender service block (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:96-107) sets no deploy.replicas; Compose runs one container per service by default.

registersWith.note: registry host from REGISTRY_HOST: "registry" (harness docker-compose_kieker.yaml:102); registry URL placeholder in web.xml:31 registryURL. Called only after persistence is available and initial training finished (RecommenderStartup.java:73-76).

exportsTelemetryTo.note: Kieker ChunkingAmqpWriter to queue 'kieker' (kieker.monitoring.properties:28,32), chunkSize=32 (:33), deferredWriteDelay=500 (:34), taskRunInterval=20 (:36). Jaeger tracer destination: library default, not in these files.
